text: Which prestige real estate agencies in Sydney are the market leaders for luxury off-the-plan developments, penthouses, and architectural project marketing?

result.keyword: Which prestige real estate agencies in Sydney are the market leaders for luxury off-the-plan developments, penthouses, and architectural project marketing?

items.markdown:
Sydney's market leaders for luxury off-the-plan developments, high-end penthouses, and architectural project marketing are dominated by `major commercial-backed international agencies and elite local boutique specialists`.[[1]](https://propertyshell.com/blog-posts/2025s-standout-projects-and-the-agencies-that-made-them-happen)

- **Colliers Residential NSW** : Undisputed market leader in major architectural project marketing, frequently handling marquee lower North Shore, eastern suburbs, and CBD fringe luxury boutique schemes (such as projects by WINIM and DA Properties).[[1]](https://www.colliers.com.au/en-au/news/colliers-residential-launches-the-oxley-in-cremorne)[[2]](https://www.luxurylist.com.au/news/2026/03/17/kl%C3%A9o-mosman-unveils-penthouse-collection-%E2%80%93-colliers/1773708998)
- **CBRE Residential Projects** : The powerhouse for large-scale ultra-luxury and landmark precinct tall-tower developments, handling record-breaking off-the-plan penthouse and multi-million dollar apartment sales across Barangaroo, the Quay, and waterfront corridors.[[1]](https://www.afr.com/property/residential/sydney-penthouse-sells-off-the-plan-for-record-9m-20200916-p55w14)[[2]](https://www.apartments.com.au/news/sell-out-on-the-hungry-mile-all-159-barangaroo-south-off-the-plan-apartments-sold-including-10-5-million-penthouse)
- **SRM Residential** : Evolved from CBRE’s elite residential projects team, specialising in end-to-end strategic project marketing and high-end urban apartment developments across metropolitan Sydney.[[1]](https://propertyshell.com/blog-posts/2025s-standout-projects-and-the-agencies-that-made-them-happen)
- **Black Diamondz** : A premier luxury specialist bridging ultra-high-net-worth local and international Asian-backed private buyers with high-end prestige developments and trophy penthouses.[[1]](https://www.blackdiamondz.com/agency)
- **Knight Frank Residential Projects** : Renowned for handling institutional-grade luxury developments, premium waterfront conversions, and high-end penthouses tailored to affluent downsizers.

If you are looking at a **specific region** (e.g., Eastern Suburbs vs. Lower North Shore) or need details on **active upcoming launches** , let me know how you want to **narrow down the scope**.
